tonight.headline: Down 12 on projection; two decisions are waiting on injury reports
body: Week 3 hasn't started. JuiceJam project 131.6 to your 119.8, and ESPN gives you 45%. Golden and Lloyd play tonight, both on your bench, and Tucker Kraft plays for JuiceJam.

One free move today: Tate into the flex for Vele — a coin flip, so take the projection. The other two cards wait on the Saturday reports for Chicago's quarterback and Barkley's neck. Don't fire them before then.

case.label: Where the gap is
case.body: Gibbs and Walker project 46.5 between them against your 38.1 at RB. No lineup move closes that. Nico Collins is questionable with a hamstring and Houston haven't given an update (NBC). If he sits, JuiceJam lose about 16 projected points.

case.label: The Monday problem
case.body: Barkley and Loveland both play Monday night. Their fallbacks, Tuten and Gadsden, play Sunday 11:00, so each decision has to be made on Saturday's report before the Monday picture is clear.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Collins practises fully Friday and Barkley is cleared. Then the gap stays about 12 and the flex choice is noise.

doFirst.title: Start Carnell Tate in the flex, bench Devaughn Vele
doFirst.subtitle: A coin flip. Take the projection — 11.8 to 11.6 — and don't read anything into it.

case.label: Why this is a coin flip
case.body: The lineup check has them 11.8 to 11.6 on projection and 8 to 10 on Week 2 opportunities, and calls it a coin flip. Standing policy: take the projection, no thesis, no log entry. It's the same rule that put Vele in last night; the answer changed because Tate arrived this morning.

case.label: What reporting adds
case.body: Tate led Tennessee with 5 targets in Week 2, but Cam Ward threw only 20 passes (CBS, NBC). Vele is the Saints' WR2 with Shough scoring 25.2 and 22.4 (PFN). The reporting leans Vele, but neither is a named role fact, and those are the only thing allowed to override the projection.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Nothing in one week's result. A coin flip that loses is still a coin flip. The rule is what's being tested: wrong if coin flips decided by projection keep losing to the other option across the season.

doFirst.sources: lineup_check.py · CBS Sports · NBC Sports · PFN

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only — decide on Saturday's Bears report, before Gadsden's 11:00 Sunday kickoff
doFirst.title: Only if the Bears list Williams out or doubtful: start Gadsden over Loveland
doFirst.subtitle: Unarmed. ESPN already shows Williams DOUBTFUL, but that's ESPN's label. Chicago's official designations for a Monday game come out Saturday.

case.label: The evidence so far
case.body: Wednesday: Williams (low-grade hamstring) did walkthrough only, Bagent is in the concussion protocol and away from the facility, and Case Keenum was the only quarterback practising. Ben Johnson is 'not sure who the starter's going to be' (SI, ESPN).

case.label: Loveland's usage
case.body: CBS (21 Sep): 1 catch for 3 yards on 5 targets through two games, 31st among tight ends. He leads the Bears in routes (61), but he was kept in to block against Minnesota's blitzes.

case.label: Gadsden's role
case.body: Njoku and Kolar are on IR for at least four games, so he's the Chargers' only active tight end (Chargers.com). Herbert is healthy; the Chargers are implied about 21.75 at Buffalo.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Williams is a full participant Friday or Saturday. The card then never fires and costs nothing.

doFirst.sources: SI · ESPN · CBS Sports · Chargers.com · VegasInsider

action.label: Start Gadsden · bench Loveland (only if Williams is out)

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only — decide on Saturday's Eagles report, before Tuten's 11:00 Sunday kickoff
doFirst.title: Only if Philadelphia rule Barkley out or doubtful: start Tuten
doFirst.subtitle: Unarmed. Barkley plays Monday, Tuten plays Sunday, so Saturday's report is the last look before Tuten locks.

case.label: What's known
case.body: Barkley hurt his neck (stinger) on his first carry in Week 2 and played 16% of snaps. An MRI was scheduled (NBC, 20 Sep). No result has been reported, and as of this morning Inside the Iggles have 'no word on the severity'.

case.label: The timing trap
case.body: If he's questionable into Monday, Tuten is already locked. A top-12 back who's merely questionable starts — standing policy, start the studs. Only OUT or DOUBTFUL moves him.

case.label: The cover
case.body: Tuten leads Jacksonville's backs in snaps and carries (SI, 24 Sep). Bigsby and Shipley would split Philadelphia's work if Barkley sits (Inside the Iggles), so there's no single handcuff worth chasing.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Barkley practises fully by Friday. The card then never fires.

doFirst.sources: NBC Sports · FantasyPros · Inside the Iggles · SI

action.label: Start Tuten · bench Barkley (only if Barkley is out)

whatWentWrong.title: Coleman cost never-resetting priority and left in 24 hours
whatWentWrong.lead: Claimed on 23 Sep at priority 3, dropped this morning without a snap. His seat is now Tate, whom the first card starts.

case.label: What it cost
case.body: Priority went from 3 to 6 in the league where it never resets. That's permanent. Tate came in free, so this morning's move cost nothing more.

case.label: The trap now
case.body: The waiver tool flags Coleman as rising (0 to 14.5 opportunities), and he's a free agent. He didn't practise Wednesday with the ankle, and RJ Harvey and J.K. Dobbins were both limited. Re-adding him would reverse a same-day drop.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Coleman leads Denver's backfield on Sunday while Tate is held under four targets. Then dropping him was the mistake, not claiming him.

lineupCheck.verdict: One coin flip: Tate over Vele in the flex, 11.8 to 11.6. Taking the projection, no thesis.

bench.detail: GB · vs ATL · THU 18:15 · Plays TONIGHT, benched. Jayden Reed doubtful (SI) and Jordan Love plays. 18 targets in two games. Below Tate and Vele by projection.

bench.detail: LAC · at BUF · SUN 11:00 · Chargers' only active tight end — Njoku and Kolar are on IR for at least four games, and Harbaugh has 'a lot of confidence' in him (Chargers.com, 21 Sep). Herbert healthy. The ghost card starts him if Chicago's quarterback falls through.

bench.name: Carnell Tate
bench.detail: TEN · at NYG · SUN 11:00 · Cam Ward throwing. 11 targets in two games; led Tennessee with 5 in Week 2, but Ward threw only 20 passes (CBS, NBC). Added free at 01:28, no priority spent. The first card puts him in the flex.

trades.theirGainLine: Their gain is +1.6 a week. Tuten replaces Rachaad White's 9.4 at RB2, and Lamar scores them nothing behind Josh Allen.

case.label: Re-checked this morning
case.body: Lamar is still in slot 20 behind Allen in slot 0; White still starts at RB2. Team 13 moved Worthy in for DJ Moore at 01:24, which doesn't touch either side. Recomputed: Bloodsports 119.8 → 123.5, Team 13 +1.6. Lamar has no injury note this week.

case.label: New since last night
case.body: Stafford is gone, so Lawrence is your only quarterback. Lamar would also be your bye-week and injury cover.

case.label: Honest risk
case.body: Season projections make it lopsided — Lamar 297.3, Tuten 166.9 — which is why it's a longshot. It works for them only on a weekly lineup view. It also takes Barkley's cover off the roster in a week when Barkley's neck is unresolved.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Team 13 start a second real back or trade a quarterback, Lamar lands on Baltimore's report, or Barkley is ruled out and Tuten has to start. Don't re-send; respond only if they open the conversation.

trades.sources: ESPN league file · Inside the Iggles
trades.copyText: Hi — would you do Lamar for Bhayshul Tuten? Lamar sits behind Allen and can't score for you, and Tuten goes straight into your RB2 ahead of White — about +1.6 a week to your lineup. Propose it in ESPN if you're in.

worthALook.name: Josh Downs
worthALook.lead: The condition in last night's decline fired: Alec Pierce is on IR. Still not an add today.

case.label: The role
case.body: Pierce (heel) went on IR on 23 Sep (NBC). Downs caught 7 of 9 targets for 72 yards in Week 2 after Pierce left, so he's now the Colts' WR1/2 for at least four weeks. Free agent, no priority cost.

case.label: Why not now
case.body: He projects 11.4, the same as Golden and below Tate and Vele, so he doesn't start this week. The only bench seats are Tate and Gadsden (added in the last day), Tuten (Barkley's cover and the trade piece) and Lloyd and Golden (both play tonight). A Yahoo headline mentions a Downs injury that I didn't check.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Next week, if Golden's role shrinks tonight with Reed back or Tate stays under five targets. Check the Yahoo item first.

worthALook.name: Adonai Mitchell
worthALook.lead: The receiver taking targets from your own starter.

case.label: The role
case.body: 9 catches on 15 targets for 123 yards through two weeks, including a team-high 12 targets in Week 2 (DraftKings Network). Geno Smith throwing.

case.label: Why not now
case.body: He wouldn't start over Tate or Vele, and every clearable seat changed hands in the last day.

case.label: When to act
case.body: If he again out-targets Garrett Wilson at Detroit. Wrong if Wilson draws nine or more and Mitchell fewer than six.

worthALook.name: Panthers D/ST
worthALook.lead: The defence comparison, answered hold for now.

case.label: The comparison
case.body: FantasyPros rank Carolina DST2 (6.94) at Cleveland and the Giants DST10 (6.32). ESPN here has 7.3 to 7.1. The Giants have lost Brian Burns for the week.

case.label: The problem
case.body: Devin Lloyd (calf) and Jaelan Phillips (back) didn't practise Wednesday and are day-to-day (PFT, Panthers.com). Lloyd was NFC Defensive Player of the Week.

case.label: When to act
case.body: If Lloyd and Phillips both practise fully on Friday. It's a free-agent swap, so no priority.

doNotChase.name: Tyler Shough
doNotChase.lead: Projects above Lawrence and is free. The case rests on two box scores.

case.label: The case for
case.body: 25.2 and 22.4 fantasy points in his two starts (PFN). ESPN projects him 17.7 to Lawrence's 16.4.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Two box scores. This quarterback slot lost 42.8 points in two weeks by chasing box scores. Lawrence has no health issue (SI, 24 Sep).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Lawrence getting hurt. Then Shough's the free-agent answer, and there's no back-up quarterback on the roster any more.

doNotChase.name: Josh Jacobs
doNotChase.lead: The best-looking name on the wire, and he isn't playing.

case.label: The fact
case.body: Still on the Commissioner's Exempt List (SI, 21 Sep). ESPN labels him DAY_TO_DAY and his season projection reads 167.6, and neither reflects that.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: The NFL reinstating him AND Green Bay activating him. Even then, Lloyd is already on your roster.

doNotChase.name: Tank Bigsby
doNotChase.lead: A handcuff to your own back, and not a clean one.

case.label: The fact
case.body: 13 carries for 33 yards and a TD while Barkley played 16% of Week 2. If Barkley sits, Bigsby and Will Shipley would split the work (Inside the Iggles, 24 Sep).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Barkley ruled out for multiple weeks with Bigsby named the lead. Tuten covers first either way.

waiverAnalysis.summary: Eight risers and two fallers, from two weeks of data — a thin sample. None is an add today. Downs has the strongest role reason, but he doesn't start and there's no open seat.

rising.name: Adonai Mitchell
rising.roleReason: Team-high 12 targets in Week 2 and 15 across two games (DraftKings Network); Geno Smith throwing. Real volume, not an injury fill-in
rising.action: WATCH — no open seat, and he doesn't start over Tate or Vele

rising.name: Josh Downs
rising.roleReason: Alec Pierce (heel) placed on IR 23 Sep (NBC); Downs caught 7 of 9 after Pierce left in Week 2. Colts WR1/2 for at least four weeks
rising.action: WATCH — role holds, but he projects equal to Golden and has no seat this week

rising.name: Rashod Bateman
rising.roleReason: Zay Flowers (hamstring) didn't practise Wednesday (ESPN's Hensley via NBC). Bateman's role exists only while Flowers is out
rising.action: WATCH — only if Baltimore rule Flowers out, and there's no seat

rising.roleReason: Moves up if Nico Collins' hamstring keeps him out (NBC, 21 Sep), but Dalton Schultz has been taking Houston's volume (PFN). Low production for the volume
rising.action: WATCH — not in the league file's wire list; injury fill-in at best

rising.name: Woody Marks
rising.roleReason: No 2026 reporting on his backfield share; NBC (21 Sep) mention him only as a possible beneficiary of Collins' hamstring. Volume that hasn't produced

rising.name: Tank Bigsby

rising.action: HOLD off — Tuten covers Barkley first

rising.roleReason: Dropped by you this morning. He didn't practise Wednesday with the ankle; Harvey and Dobbins were both limited (Denver Gazette). PFN's 20 Sep 'in line for work' came before the ankle

rising.action: WATCH — no path to a lead role

falling.action: HOLD — Gadsden is the conditional start if Williams is out

falling.name: Oronde Gadsden
falling.roleReason: His two low weeks came behind Njoku and Kolar; both are now on IR and he's the only active Chargers tight end (Chargers.com). The role expands from Week 3
